Name: Main
BaselineValidationScript: SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT MAX(Version) FROM dbo.SchemaVersion WHERE Product = 'Shop'), 0) <= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT)
VersionStampScript: MERGE dbo.SchemaVersion AS t USING (SELECT 'Shop' AS Product, 1 AS Version) AS s ON t.Product = s.Product WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET Version = s.Version WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (Product, Version) VALUES (s.Product, s.Version);
